subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename bootstrap files as a core `bootstrap-extra-files` hook contract, or keep the hook limited to recognized workspace filenames?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing deterministic system-prompt context and the hook file-loading contract is a product/security boundary decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
options.body: Allow custom-basename workspace files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, session filtering, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and close or redirect custom-file requests to narrower first-class filename or workspace-convention proposals.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep current behavior for now and design a broader context-file API before adding another deterministic startup-context surface.

recommendation.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
recommendation.body: Allow custom-basename workspace files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, session filtering, docs, and tests.
